plain: Pushed out or removed, as from a place, a job or a right

example.quote: If you intend to reserve your unalienable rights, you must have the most express stipulation ; for, if implication be allowed, you are ousted of those rights.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 16, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
